Natural generated IDs, accepted drafts, target/draft rows and later histories differ across arms. These are complete natural consumer observations, not equal-mathematical-work speed or task-quality rankings.
Rates are per-arm medians of3. All original samples/ranges and clocks are archived; no statistical-significance claim.

Memory uses1 independent process per arm/workload, excluded from throughput medians. PDH/PSAPI sampled peaks are observations/lower bounds; dedicated/shared maxima and RAM/commit must not be summed as physical memory.
Loading/ready retain original producer boundaries and existing OS file caches. Default report/IO cost remains inside its natural boundaries.
Old-window nonclock equality does not make cross-day TPS deltas causal. No isolated optimization attribution, B2/multi-user throughput, other-model/backend/quantization or quality claim.
